title: PSG Face Major Doué Setback as ACL Surgery Looms
body:
Paris Saint-Germain have a serious problem on their hands, with Désiré Doué facing an operation on a ruptured anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee [S1].

The damage came during a 3-2 Ligue 1 win over Nice [S2]. Doué had just put his side 2-1 ahead, then twisted awkwardly late in the first half while trying to control the ball, and he left the pitch in tears [S2].

The Guardian tied the blow to an earlier setback, noting that Doué's injury came on top of Kvaratskhelia's, which happened last month [S2]. That is the detail that matters most, because it turns one absence into a pattern.

This is where squad depth gets tested, and that is where seasons are quietly decided. A creative player who can change a match in one moment leaves a hole that no bench fills neatly, and a thin bench is exactly what turns one blow into a crisis. The better sides keep producing even when their best attacking options are missing, and the ones that don't tend to drift.

The Touchline Take: how the squad copes will define the next month.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: PSG's Doue to have surgery on ruptured ACL. Paris St-Germain forward Desire Doue will have surgery later this month after rupturing the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee.

The Guardian: European football: Doué carried off for PSG while Kane vows to return fresh. Doué injury adds to that of Kvaratskhelia last month. Nice 2-3 PSG; Lazio 3-0 Lecce; Gladbach 0-1 Dortmund. Désiré Doué was carried off in tears after suffering what looked like a nasty knee injury as Paris Saint-Germain beat Nice 3-2 in Ligue 1. Doué went down after twisting awkwardly late in the first half as he tried to control the ball, shortly after scoring to put PSG 2-1 ahead.
